title: Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024

clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements, tolerances, test methods, and compliance specifications for Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear as prescribed under IS 15298 (PART 2) by the Bureau of Indian Standards.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Indian Standard Code of Practice / Test Method (IS 15298)

marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
